ev.q: During the reporting week of August 28--September 3, a total of 414 human cases of WNV infection were reported from 22 states
Of 1,172 (63%) cases for which demographic data were available, 660 (56%) occurred among males
including 16 fatal cases from eight states (Iowa, Missouri, Nebraska, New Mexico, New York, South Dakota, Texas, and Wyoming)
Of 1,172 (63%) cases for which demographic data were available, 660 (56%) occurred among males
a total of 1,856 human cases of WNV infection have been reported from Colorado
This report summarizes West Nile virus (WNV) surveillance data reported to CDC through ArboNET
